kurz: Acid makes flavour fresher, keeps vegetables firm, turns red cabbage red and stops apples browning.
bild_im_kopf: Like a light switch for flavour: one splash and everything seems brighter.
was_passiert: Acid lowers the [[ph-wert|pH]]. That changes pigments, slows [[enzym|enzymes]] and keeps the glue in plant cells firmer. In the mouth it balances fat and sweetness.
faustregeln: If a dish tastes flat, it is often acid that is missing, not salt.
With green vegetables, add it only at the end.
